REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)
RFI Number: RFI-2026-001
Subject: Clash between 600mm Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04 at Level 02

Drawing Reference: DR-S-201, DR-M-402
Raised Date: 2026-02-10
Due Date: 2026-02-17

QUESTION:
